cards.ex: After a few minor concessions, we finally sealed the deal.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta kichik yon berishlardan so'ng, nihoyat bitimni yakunladik.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvni rasman tugatish, imzolash yoki tasdiqlash.

cards.ex: To sweeten the pot, they offered free shipping.
cards.exUz: Taklifni yaxshilash uchun ular bepul yetkazib berishni taklif qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Taklifni yanada jozibali qilish, qo'shimcha imtiyozlar berish.

cards.ex: Negotiations are at a standstill due to disagreements about the price.
cards.exUz: Narx bo'yicha kelishmovchiliklar tufayli muzokaralar to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Jarayon yoki muzokara to'xtab qolgan, rivojlanmayotgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Make sure you do your homework before the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin uy vazifangizni bajarishingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida batafsil ma'lumot to'plash, tayyorgarlik ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: Okay, let's get down to business and discuss the budget.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, ishga kirishamiz va byudjetni muhokama qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzuga o'tish, muhim masalalarni muhokama qilishni boshlash.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to find a solution.
cards.exUz: Yechim topish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, ijodiy yondashuvlarni izlash, odatiy usullardan voz kechish.

cards.ex: We need to make sure everyone is on the same page before we proceed.
cards.exUz: Davom etishdan oldin hamma bir fikrda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil tushunchaga ega bo'lish, bir fikrda bo'lish, kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the project cost?
cards.exUz: Loyiha narxi uchun taxminiy raqamni ayta olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, taxminiy qiymat yoki raqam.

cards.ex: As the CEO, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor sifatida u bu yerda buyruq berish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror vaziyatni nazorat qilish, qarorlar qabul qilish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company cut corners to increase profits.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foydani oshirish uchun tejamkorlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun sifatni qurbon qilish, arzonroq usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'yinni o'zgartiruvchi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan yangilik yoki voqea.

cards.ex: He always goes the extra mile to please his clients.
cards.exUz: U har doim mijozlarini xursand qilish uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy talablardan ko'proq harakat qilish, a'lo natijaga erishish uchun ko'proq kuch sarflash.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Bizda rejalashtirilgan bir nechta yangi loyihalar bor.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshirilishi rejalashtirilgan, tayyorlanayotgan yoki kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishlashni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatning asosiy qoidalarini va jarayonlarini o'rganish.

cards.ex: It's a lose-lose situation; no matter what we do, someone will be unhappy.
cards.exUz: Bu yutqazish vaziyati; nima qilsak ham, kimdir xursand bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday natija yomon bo'ladigan, hech kim yutmaydigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Accepting the offer was a no-brainer.
cards.exUz: Taklifni qabul qilish oson qaror edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga hojat yo'q, aniq va osongina qabul qilinadigan qaror.

cards.ex: We've put that project on the back burner for now.
cards.exUz: Biz hozircha bu loyihani kechiktirdik.
cards.uzDef: Hozircha muhim bo'lmagan, keyinroq ko'rib chiqiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: They're playing hardball in these negotiations.
cards.exUz: Ular bu muzokaralarda qat'iy kurashmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qat'iy, murosasiz usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: This project has really raised the bar for future projects.
cards.exUz: Bu loyiha kelajakdagi loyihalar uchun talablarni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarni, talablarni yuqori darajaga ko'tarish.

cards.ex: Let's take this discussion offline.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu muhokamani shaxsiy tarzda o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Katta guruhdan tashqarida, shaxsiy uchrashuvda yoki telefon orqali muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the progress.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta yutuqlarni muhokama qilish uchun aloqada bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa uchrashuv o'tkazish, fikr almashish, yangiliklarni bilish.

cards.ex: They were accused of making under the table payments.
cards.exUz: Ular yashirincha to'lovlar qilishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy bo'lmagan, yashirincha amalga oshiriladigan to'lovlar yoki bitimlar.

cards.ex: It's a win-win situation for everyone involved.
cards.exUz: Bu barcha ishtirokchilar uchun yutuqli vaziyat.
cards.uzDef: Har ikki tomon ham foyda ko'radigan vaziyat, kelishuv.

cards.ex: The deal fell through, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Bitim bekor bo'ldi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatga qaytish, boshidan boshlash.

cards.ex: We always do things by the book here.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yerda har doim qoidalarga rioya qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga, qonunlarga va standartlarga qat'iy rioya qilgan holda.

cards.ex: Let's aim to finish this by close of play today.
cards.exUz: Bugun kun oxirigacha buni tugatishga harakat qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Ish kunining oxiri, ish vaqtining tugashi.

cards.ex: We need to perform due diligence before investing.
cards.exUz: Investitsiya qilishdan oldin sinchkov tekshiruv o'tkazishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida to'liq ma'lumot olish uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan tekshirish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu loyihani boshlaylik.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni boshlash, harakatga keltirish.

cards.ex: Several options are on the table.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta variantlar muhokama qilinmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muhokama qilinayotgan, ko'rib chiqilayotgan masala yoki taklif.

cards.ex: The employees pushed back against the new policy.
cards.exUz: Xodimlar yangi siyosatga qarshi norozilik bildirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Taklifga yoki qarorga qarshi norozilik bildirish, e'tiroz bildirish.
